_comment: Bard song parts per class (class name as in races_classes): part is melody, verse, embellishment, bridge, lyric, chorus, coda or rest; energy is the cost per second while the song plays (a rest lowers it); stat/bonus is what the part adds to the song's buff (the melody picks the stat). The real song parts were server data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md); these are placeholders.
